summary: Copy the pattern adjacent to the red anchor block in the top-left quadrant to other quadrants, scaling and reflecting based on the relative size and position of matching red anchor blocks.
src: colored pixels adjacent to the red anchor block in top-left quadrant s
dst: positions adjacent to red anchor blocks in other quadrants d
match_cond: s.anchor_color == d.anchor_color (both red); scale_factor = d.red_block.size / s.red_block.size; reflection determined by quadrant relationship
multi_step: Step 1: identify red anchor blocks in each quadrant; Step 2: compute scale factor from red block size ratios; Step 3: determine reflection axis from quadrant positions (horizontal for left-right, vertical for top-bottom); Step 4: copy scaled and reflected pattern to each target quadrant anchored at its red block
